reviews.text: Friendly, professional service. They take their time if it turns out there is more going on than expected. Also available by phone for quick questions.

⭐️⭐️

Very disappointed with my experience today. I arrived just a few minutes late for my appointment, and despite this, they refused to see me and I ended up losing my appointment.

What I find particularly frustrating is that on many previous occasions, I have had to wait considerably longer than the few minutes I was late today, and I have never received the same level of consideration from the clinic.

I completely understand the importance of respecting appointment times, but I believe there should be some flexibility and, above all, consistency. If clients are expected to accept significant waiting times when the clinic is running late, I think it is reasonable to expect the same understanding when a client is a few minutes late.

After having visited this clinic several times, I expected a more understanding and professional approach. Unfortunately, today’s experience was unnecessarily rigid and very disappointing.
We have had our vaccines here for our new puppy. The vets are super nice and kind, they give you enough time and attention. We are happy we found this place 💕 …

Always helpful, and often have available slots for non-emergency but still priority unplanned needs (sudden illness).
Nice team.

My cat had surgery yesterday, and everything was handled so well. I was very emotional when I dropped her off, but the team sent me a photo of her waking up after the procedure, which really reassured me. They also called the next day to check on how she was doing. Everyone was incredibly kind and supportive throughout the whole process. I’m so grateful to have found this clinic in Amsterdam, truly the nicest people and such a wonderful place. I highly recommend it.
Great first time experience with my dog here. Met with Dr. Kalapnathsing who was excellent. The entire staff was kind, spoke English, and showed patience with my nervous dog.
Extremely satisfied with the service at Dierenkliniek De Jordaan.
The women at reception are very friendly and gorgeous too...😇 …

My dog have been registrated here about 2 years and resultts of our visit to this clinik I understand that here also good for vaccination but about x-ray and ultra sound I dont recommend you . Because my dog was 1st time pregnant and when I took her to make ultra sound. The doctor said that she is not good reading ultra sound but x- ray she can. I said ok then make x-ray and let me know how many puppies there .She made and discussed with other doctors too and replied that my dog has minimum 3 but she thinks there are 4 pupplies 3 is garantee. Time passed my dog gave only 2 pappies. I was afraid for her and showed the picture of x-ray to other doctors from different clinik  and more 5 doctor said that she had only 2 puppies no more.
So think good before going to this clinik for x-ray or for ultra sound.It can cost of life of your pet.

I am so happy with this veterinary clinic. The staff are friendly and helpful. The vet (Lisa) has a lot of patience treating my kittens, especially Vincenzo. Thank you for the good care 🫶🏻😻 Best regards, Cleo - Clara - Vincenzo …

Very bad experience at this clinic!
Not recommended!

A fantastic veterinary clinic with good care and very friendly people. When my cat passed away, I received a handwritten card a few days later. It is truly very special and nice how much extra attention and effort they put into your pet here.
Very pleasant experience! Friendly and very knowledgeable.

Extemely bad service. Took an appointment and they kept me waiting for 45 mins with my cat mewing no stop and other 5 people waiting in the room with cats and dogs around. They should be more organized and polite to customers

A heartbreaking experience. My elderly friend, who has early-stage dementia, brought his beloved dog Timmy here for a check-up. Somehow, the vet decided to euthanize her—without clear communication, without my friend’s proper understanding or without discussing it with anyone else.

Timmy was an old, but happy and loved dog who still had life and joy in her. Now she’s gone. Her owner is left confused and devastated, calling me constantly, asking where she is. I reached out to the clinic for answers and was met with silence—they refuse to explain what happened.

It is deeply disturbing that such a decision could be made so lightly, with no transparency or accountability. An animal is gone, a vulnerable person is suffering, and this clinic acts like it's just business as usual. Unacceptable.
I go there since I come to Amsterdam!I am very satisfied with any of the vet from here and also the prices are very convenient!

From the very first step I took inside your premises, it felt good, warm, and familiar, and I felt very welcome.
Even though I had never been to your place before, I was able to come to you that same day with my cat Vlek, who is over 18 years old.
Thanks to your quick action, she was spared further suffering, and I am immensely grateful for that!
Once again, thank you so much for everything; I also found the card I received from you heartwarming, and I hope I can come to you again in the future.
Had a very nice experience, really very satisfied😇 …
Great vet!

Very, and I mean VERY, friendly people at this clinic.

We were helped quickly and skillfully by the assistants and doctor, plus a one-time payment and two follow-ups were included.

It is just that they are located a bit further away and parking is a nightmare, but otherwise we probably would have switched.
Really nice and helpful staff for my reactive dog Richard. Both at reception and in the doctor's office. Highly recommend.
